_comment: R4 (LOCAL_LLM_WORK.md, Jonathan's carte blanche of 28 Oct 2026): certified KV tile skipping after a model change. Two 20M models at E1's 20m_L16 shape (d 320, 16 layers x 5 heads, d_ff 864), seed 1, E1's data job (mix_s35, byte-identical: pinned sources, seed 1) and recipe (10,000 steps x 16,384 tokens = 163.84M, lr 1e-3, cosine, warmup 500) at T 2,048 (batch 4 x accum 2): r4_base, plain softmax, and r4_qkt, QK-norm (per-head q/k RMSNorm) with a learned per-head temperature on the normed q (arch.custom.qk_temp, init 2.75 = log2(T^2 - T) / sqrt(64): Henry et al. 2020's initial scale on the RMS-normed form). Checkpoint every 200 steps (~3 min), relay every 400. Home: weights, GGUF + IR, events, result.json. Measured at home on the CPU by experiments/exact_kv_skip_2026-10-28/kvskip_measure_2k.py. This file: r4_base (Colab L4 pk-r4-base).
